name: Kougami Nagisa
source: A famous actress that was sent to hot springs by manager. Has recently lost popularity and took advice to avoid public until can land next gig. As can imagine her personality is that of a selfish spoiled celeb. Tease and commands protagonist as he is a big fan of hers and only real entertainment in hot spring to her.
